name: app.gathergate/gathergate
title: GatherGate
description: Self-hosted client document checklist, validator, and auto-chaser with metadata-only MCP tools.

runtimeArguments.name: -y
runtimeArguments.description: Skip interactive npx package confirmation prompt

packageArguments.description: Start GatherGate's zero-dependency stdio-to-HTTP MCP bridge

environmentVariables.name: GATHERGATE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your self-hosted GatherGate instance (e.g. https://intake.yourfirm.com.au or http://127.0.0.1:3080)

environmentVariables.name: GATHERGATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Scoped workspace API key (gg_live_...) with mcp:read (plus requests:write for creating packs or sending reminders)

host.description: Hostname (and optional port) of your self-hosted GatherGate instance, e.g. intake.yourfirm.com.au

api_key.description: Scoped workspace API key (gg_live_...) with mcp:read (plus requests:write for creating packs or sending reminders)
